title: Build 39-dimensional MFCC features
brief: Compute MFCCs with an orthonormal DCT-II, lifter them, add regression deltas, and normalize each utterance so a fixed channel cancels out.
hints: Build the DCT as an (M, M) matrix: np.cos(np.pi * n[:, None] * (2 * m[None, :] + 1) / (2 * M)), scale row 0 by sqrt(1 / M) and the others by sqrt(2 / M), then multiply it by x.
power_to_db floors against the maximum of the whole matrix after the log: db = np.maximum(db, db.max() - top_db).
np.pad(c, ((0, 0), (width, width)), mode="edge") repeats the first and last frames, so every shifted slice has T columns.
The HTK lifter indexes rows from n = 0, so c0 keeps weight 1. librosa's lifter starts at n = 1 and scales c0 too; that is a different convention.
Normalize along axis 1 with keepdims=True, so the (rows, 1) means and deviations broadcast over time.
